title: Strongly convex gradient-step contraction
target_statement: For a C1 globally alpha-strongly convex function with beta quadratic upper model on a complete real inner-product space, alpha,beta,h>=0 and beta*h<=1 imply that x-h grad f(x) contracts distances by sqrt(1-alpha*h).
